title: Remove Google Play Services dependency
symptom: The user wants to remove the Google Play Services dependency from xDrip+ because they don't want Google to collect their data and they don't understand why it is required. They note that they don't use Wear OS and the notification is already persistent, so they question the need for Google Messaging Services.
cause: xDrip+ follower mode, when enabled, uses Google Messaging. The dependency is required for the xDrip+ Sync Follower mechanism, which is one of the available sync mechanisms.
fix: xDrip should run without Google Play Services installed. There is an option 'Disable all sync features' in 'xDrip+ sync settings' which should permanently disable this subsystem from being initialized. Alternatively, users can use Nightscout follower scheme with no need for Google.
evidence_quote: There is also the option `Disable all sync features` in `xDrip+ sync settings` which should permanently disable this subsystem from being initialized, which might also help if you are getting issues.
